items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Peter Fountain gets a big fat tone too.

ctx.x: Yeah. Peter Fountain gets a big fat tone too. He gets a big fat tone.
He does too. There's something about the albert. I wonder sometimes if it's imagination too, but still the symphony players even say that. I've got a BAME at home.
